svg.title: How the numbers are checked
svg.desc: The judge's verdicts match blind labels on 55 of 67 answers and were never too lenient; blind labelers agreed on 36 of 36 shared replies and caught 17 of 18 known-wrong answers across three sealed sets; the answer check caught 8 of 8 wrong answers in its test; 120 sealed questions were written blind and run once per version; CI replays a recorded run on every push.
svg.text: caught in its test (2 of 12 right flagged)

tool change the model sees fails
